title: Direct image of sequence modules commutes with finite evaluation
statement: For a prime ell, finite E/Q_ell, arbitrary scheme map f:X -> Y and nonnegative level n, whole-sequence module direct image followed by evaluation at n is naturally isomorphic to finite coefficient-module direct image after evaluating on X. The hom of the comparison is the identity on every underlying section, expressed by HEq. This is the canonical_exists finite-level substep of [lem-trf-ordinary-quotient-pullback-tower-comparison], using the actual whole-sequence site and coefficient maps [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. No residue-characteristic, invertibility, constructibility or completeness condition is imposed.

proof.text: Compare the two composite ordinary sheaf-module pushforwards using their composition isomorphisms and the actual equality of the coefficient-ring maps on every section. Their restriction and scalar actions agree, so both maps and inverses are identity on the underlying section types. Compose the comparisons, retaining their HEq formulas. This is the existing proved private canonical_exists construction, not a new obligation.
